items.source: A specification for retry attempts on a given method, combining common retry characteristics. This roughly matches the annotation attributes on Retryable.
items.translation: 给定方法的重试尝试规范，结合了常见的重试特性。这大致匹配 Retryable 上的注解属性。

items.source: includes - applicable exception types to attempt a retry for
items.translation: includes - 尝试重试的适用异常类型

items.source: excludes - non-applicable exception types to avoid a retry for
items.translation: excludes - 为避免重试的非适用异常类型。

items.source: predicate - a predicate for filtering exceptions from applicable methods
items.translation: predicate - 用于从适用方法中过滤异常的谓词

items.source: maxRetries - the maximum number of retry attempts
items.translation: maxRetries - 最大重试尝试次数

items.source: delay - the base delay after the initial invocation
items.translation: delay - 初始调用后的基础延迟

items.source: jitter - a jitter value for the next retry attempt
items.translation: 抖动 - 下一次重试尝试的抖动值

items.source: multiplier - a multiplier for a delay for the next retry attempt
items.translation: multiplier - 下一次重试尝试延迟的倍数

items.source: maxDelay - the maximum delay for any retry attempt
items.translation: maxDelay - 任何重试尝试的最大延迟

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
items.translation: 指示其他对象是否“等于”此对象。如果另一个对象为同一类且所有记录组件均相等，则这两个对象相等。引用组件使用Objects::equals(Object,Object)进行比较；基本组件使用其对应包装类的compare方法进行比较。

items.source: Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one.
